summary: Full plan in seo-growth.md (38 fix specs, 9 sections, 7 appendices). Core finding: the traffic gap is a 3.5-month-old domain (RDAP: registered 2026-06-13, expires 2027-06-13) plus a thin, JS-rendered, non-unique surface, not a Lighthouse issue. Search referrals are 173/2,221 (7.8%); Bing+DDG+Yahoo (110) exceed Google (63). New verified facts: Search Console verification file is 404 and DNS has no TXT (ownership likely lost); the OG/PWA image is a corrupt near-black gradient used on 21 pages; 10 of 20 sub-pages lack twitter:card; friendly-lolly-da85c0.netlify.app serves the full site with 200 and no redirect; /landing.html (old pricing page) 404s; 10 pages link to /index.html; sitemap has 21 URLs and no lastmod. Programmatic pages built from today's data would be thin (regiment median 17 words, brigade median 120, 0 of 101 reach 250; 127 units share duplicate key_action), so the plan tiers indexation, gates it on measured uniqueness (CI thin-content gate), and funds an enrichment corpus shared with the Historian expansion. Plan covers: GSC/Bing/IndexNow, canonical/redirect system (extensionless), rename to Gettysburg Interactive Map (competitor collision with ABT and the paid Savas Beatie app), landing-first home with app at /map (with cloaking risk matrix: not cloaking by Google's definition but fragile), JSON-LD per template, build-time OG images, static mini-maps (protects Mapbox quota), ~340 Tier-A URLs (moments, OOB tree, places, ancestors by state, learn, trust; up to ~580 with Tier B and Q&A), E-E-A-T pages, open dataset with DOI, AI-crawler policy and llms.txt, keyword map, 9-competitor review, outreach programme with named targets, classroom kit, embeds, video, editorial calendar, cookieless analytics with privacy-policy update, bot-segmentation experiments, monitoring/CI, 12-week roadmap with KPIs (search referrals 173 -> 500/30d, AI 14 -> 50, +20 referring domains by day 90) and risk register. Effort: ~77.5 person-days total, ~50 in the 90-day scope, 33 for a core subset if capacity is under 3 days/week. Targets are planning numbers (no keyword-volume data available); provenance/licensing questions (Busey and Martin; three data notes referencing a 'Gettysburg Animated YouTube vignette') need owner answers before open-licensing or scaling.

findings.title: Re-establish Search Console and Bing Webmaster ownership (DNS TXT), submit sitemaps, add IndexNow
findings.evidence: google0dca4879c9657741.html existed in deploy B only (deploy-history.md:114) and now 404s; nslookup -type=TXT returns SOA only (no verification records); no google-site-verification/msvalidate meta in deploy:index.html head. DNS is Netlify DNS (NS1).
findings.root_cause: Verification was an HTML file dropped by a later hand-assembled deploy; nothing durable (DNS/meta) replaced it.
findings.fix: Add a Domain property in GSC via TXT in Netlify DNS; import to Bing Webmaster Tools; submit sitemap.xml in both; request indexing for 6 hub URLs; add IndexNow key file at root and POST changed URLs from the deploy step; snapshot baselines (Performance, Pages, Links, Crawl stats, Bing inbound links); add a second owner account.
findings.acceptance_test: Both properties show Ownership verified via DNS; sitemap status Success; URL Inspection returns a status for 6 seeded URLs within 14 days; IndexNow key file returns 200 and first POST returns 200/202.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Measurement, indexing speed, every SEO KPI (T1)
findings.correction: All evidence reproduced (404, TXT SOA-only, no meta, deploy-history.md:114, NS1). Addition: the original 52-byte google0dca4879c9657741.html still exists in Downloads and tmp-deploy-history/b_jun23; restoring it can re-verify the old property with history before or alongside the DNS Domain property. IndexNow POST from the deploy step needs a pipeline that does not exist yet (manual zip deploys).

findings.title: Replace the corrupt og:image/PWA screenshot with valid distinct cards; complete twitter/og tags on all pages
findings.evidence: screenshots/day3.png (used by og:image/twitter:image on 21 pages and both manifest screenshots): IHDR RGB 1280x720 but IDAT inflates to 3,687,120 B (RGBA rows); PIL raises 'unrecognized data stream contents'; decoded as RGBA it is a near-black gradient with 80 colours; day1.png is byte-identical (md5 3f6646c9...). 10 pages lack twitter:card (ar, cinematic-export, find-ancestor, ground-remembers, historian, immersive, living-ledger, regiment, turning-points, watch-together); no og:site_name/og:image:width/height/alt anywhere; only index.html links icons/manifest.
findings.root_cause: A generator wrote a mismatched header and a synthetic gradient; the same file was reused for two 'days' and copy-pasted into later pages.
findings.fix: Interim: hand-made 1200x630 8-bit RGB og/default.png <= 150 KB with real map crop and brand; two genuine 1280x720 and two 750x1334 manifest screenshots; point all og/twitter images at it; add og:image:width/height/alt, twitter:image:alt, og:site_name, og:locale; add twitter block to the 10 pages and og to privacy/terms; add icon/apple-touch-icon/manifest/theme-color links to every page; re-scrape in Facebook Debugger and LinkedIn Inspector. Final per-page art is seo-growth-11.
findings.acceptance_test: Pillow decodes every referenced image; curl -I shows image/png <= 200 KB; Facebook debugger shows a valid 1200x630 card for /, /documentary, /find-ancestor; grep finds twitter:card on all 20 sub-pages; CI fails on a non-decoding og image.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Share previews, click-through from shares, PWA install sheet; SEO/social
findings.correction: Core defect exactly reproduced. Fixes: twitter:image is on 11 pages (og:image on 21); Slack has no /unfurl command (no purge API, cache about 30 min; use a new image URL, ?v=, or delete and repost); interim real screenshots would bake in C3/C4/C1/C2 defects (see MISSED-7).

findings.title: One canonical URL per page: extensionless canonicals, generated 301s, netlify.app host redirect, /landing.html, fix internal /index.html links
findings.evidence: curl: / and /index.html, /dashboard and /dashboard.html, /historian and /historian.html all 200; friendly-lolly-da85c0.netlify.app serves full site 200 with no X-Robots-Tag or redirect; /landing.html (old pricing page in Aug 22 sitemap) now 404; http://www takes two hops. Netlify Analytics lists /index.html (86) beside / (1,713) and /historian (68) beside /historian.html (42). 10 pages link 'Back to the map' to /index.html (aftermath:41, camera:46, compare:53, dashboard:58, documentary:47, education:42, report:49, sandbox:52, search:50, viewshed:43). netlify.toml comment on the diagnostics rule proves force=true is required because Netlify serves an existing file before redirects.
findings.root_cause: Netlify serves /x and /x.html for the same file, nothing redirects, and internal links/emitters use /index.html and .html.
findings.fix: Decision: extensionless, no trailing slash, apex, https. Generate explicit force=true 301 rows (from the page manifest) for /X.html -> /X, /index.html -> /, /landing.html -> /, and https://friendly-lolly-da85c0.netlify.app/* -> apex; set primary domain so http://www is one hop. In the same deploy change every canonical, og:url, sitemap loc, JSON-LD url and internal href (site-nav.js GROUPS, #seo-content nav, 10 back links, emitters documentary.html:92, education.html:81, search.html, historian.html:110, embed.html:60, regiment.html:247, turning-points.html:118) to the canonical form; strip utm/ref with history.replaceState. Note divergence: prov-recon-35 keeps .html; either works if consistent.
findings.acceptance_test: Appendix D curl matrix: every legacy variant returns exactly one 301 to canonical and final 200 with matching link rel=canonical; netlify.app returns 301; Netlify Analytics shows no .html or /index.html rows after 7 days; GSC shows extensionless URL as user-declared canonical.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Analytics accuracy, link consolidation, crawl efficiency (T3)
findings.correction: Curl matrix, Analytics rows (/ 1,713, /index.html 86, /historian 68, /historian.html 42), the 10 back-link lines and the netlify.app 200 all confirmed, and the force redirect is right (Netlify does not auto-redirect the default subdomain). Corrections: historian.html:110, regiment.html:247 and turning-points.html:118 already emit root-form /?tick=, /?unit=; the /index.html emitters are documentary:92, education:81, embed:60, search:114/127/139. Setting the apex as primary domain is a no-op because apex is already primary and the second hop is Netlify's HTTPS upgrade. The plan does not re-key path-scoped netlify.toml rules for extensionless URLs (MISSED-1) and leaves the conflict with prov-recon-35/36 (.html canonical) unresolved.

findings.title: Decide and apply the name 'Gettysburg Interactive Map' (drop 'Animated Battlefield Map' and 'minute-by-minute')
findings.evidence: Title/H1/JSON-LD/manifest say 'Gettysburg Animated Battlefield Map' (deploy:index.html:14,718; manifest.json name) while the domain says 'interactive'. Competitors: ABT 'Gettysburg Animated Map', Savas Beatie 'Gettysburg Animated Battle Map APP' ($49.95, 430,000+ placements), YouTube 'Gettysburg - Fully Animated', 2019 film 'Gettysburg/Antietam: Animated Battle Map' on Apple TV/Tubi (WebSearch). Copy says 'minute-by-minute' beside 'five-minute snapshots' (index.html:718-719).
findings.root_cause: Title chosen from the feature, not the search landscape; the exact phrase is shared with a paid product and video content.
findings.fix: Brand 'Gettysburg Interactive Map'; title pattern '{keywords} | Gettysburg Interactive Map' (<=60, drop brand if longer); home 'Gettysburg Interactive Map: The Battle in Five-Minute Steps' (59); WebSite name + alternateName ['Gettysburg Animated Battlefield Map'] for transition; manifest name/short_name; add 'not affiliated with NPS, ABT or any publisher' line; update all 23 titles, site-nav brand, privacy/terms, guide PDF, embed. Owner to weigh the trademark-confusion point with advice.
findings.acceptance_test: grep -ri 'Animated Battlefield Map' finds only alternateName and changelog; all indexable titles <= 60; GSC site-name test shows new name after recrawl.
findings.correction: Title/h1/manifest lines and Savas Beatie figures verified ($49.95, 430,000+, 2,400+, 8,000+, 8 yrs, Tom Marchesani). Minor: the YouTube channel is 'Gettysburg Battle - Fully Animated'; the Apple TV listing is unconfirmed; the 2019 Tubi film is an ABT product; the acceptance grep for 'minute-by-minute' misses 'minute by minute' in site-nav.js:46 and living-ledger.html.

findings.title: Per-page metadata, indexability disposition and visible intro copy for all 27 HTML files
findings.evidence: Static word counts of the 20 feature pages: 27 (search) to 330 (aftermath), median ~100; 4 titles >60 chars (aftermath 71, dashboard 67, find-ancestor 67, education 61); 11 descriptions <110 chars; content of documentary/turning-points/education/find-ancestor/historian/regiment is fetch()-rendered (documentary.html:88-91, turning-points.html:51).
findings.root_cause: 37-character brand suffix crowds titles; pages are tool shells with JS-injected content.
findings.fix: Apply the disposition table in the report: index pages get >=150 server-rendered words, one h1, breadcrumbs, JSON-LD; search.html and /map noindex,follow; compare/camera/sandbox/viewshed/ground-remembers/living-ledger/immersive index only if >=150 unique words; education merges into /learn; unit-rendering-reference removed from production; new titles <=60 and descriptions 120-155.
findings.acceptance_test: Crawl script: one h1 per page, titles <=60, descriptions 120-155, no duplicates, all Index pages >=150 raw-HTML words; GSC shows no 'Duplicate, submitted URL not selected as canonical'.
findings.correction: Titles over 60 (71/67/67/61) exact; descriptions under 110 = 11 including privacy/terms; static word counts within method tolerance (mine 20-321 vs 27-330). turning-points.html content is an inline JS array (const POINTS, lines 50-100), not fetch()-rendered.

findings.title: Sitemap index with real lastmod, robots.txt with explicit AI-crawler policy, llms.txt
findings.evidence: deploy:sitemap.xml has 21 <loc>, 0 <lastmod>, only changefreq/priority; robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' plus Sitemap; /llms.txt 404. Sample robots.txt validated with urllib.robotparser (GPTBot allowed /moments but blocked /data/; Googlebot/Bingbot/OAI-SearchBot allowed /data/).
findings.root_cause: Sitemap was a single hand-made list; no crawler policy or per-section reporting.
findings.fix: sitemap.xml becomes an index of per-section files (core, moments, battle, units, places, people, ancestors, learn, trust) so GSC reports indexed/submitted per template; lastmod from git content date; drop changefreq/priority; robots: default allow, training-crawler group (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider, meta-externalagent) Disallow /data/, search/answer bots and user fetchers in default group (OAI-SearchBot must stay allowed for ChatGPT search); llms.txt + llms-full.txt (low expected value, cheap); max-image-preview:large meta; cache sitemaps 3600 s.
findings.acceptance_test: Robotparser matrix passes; index validates in GSC and Bing with each child Success; every child URL is 200, indexable, self-canonical (CI); /llms.txt 200 text/plain.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Discovery, per-section indexing stats, AI visibility (E5)
findings.correction: Sitemap 21 loc/0 lastmod, 3-line robots.txt, /llms.txt 404, both cached 86,400 s verified; OpenAI doc confirms OAI-SearchBot must not be blocked for ChatGPT search and ChatGPT-User may ignore robots. Non-OpenAI/Anthropic crawler token spellings remain unverified, as the report says.

findings.title: Domain continuity: renew multi-year, keep lock, add second contact
findings.evidence: RDAP: registration 2026-06-13, expiration 2027-06-13 (one week before the June 26-July 3 anniversary peak), status client transfer prohibited; single Gmail contact in site footer (site-nav.js:194).
findings.root_cause: Default one-year registration.
findings.fix: Enable auto-renew, renew 5-10 years, second contact email, calendar reminder 2027-05-13.
findings.acceptance_test: RDAP expiration >= 2031-06-13; registrar shows auto-renew on.
findings.correction: RDAP: registered 2026-06-13, expires 2027-06-13, client transfer prohibited.

findings.title: Manifest and PWA discoverability hygiene
findings.evidence: deploy:manifest.json: orientation landscape; purpose 'any maskable' on both icons; no id/lang; screenshots point to the corrupt duplicated file; icons decode fine (4 colours, inset border).
findings.root_cause: Landscape-only app assumption and copied manifest template.
findings.fix: Remove orientation; id '/map' ('/' until landing-first ships); start_url '/map?source=pwa' after 09; lang en-US; name/short_name per 04; split any/maskable icons with safe-zone art; wide+narrow real screenshots with form_factor; shortcuts (Day 1/2/3 ticks, order of battle).
findings.acceptance_test: Lighthouse installability passes; DevTools Manifest shows no warnings and shows screenshots; portrait phone installs and rotates.
findings.correction: Manifest facts exact. Hazard: setting id '/' now and '/map' when landing-first ships changes PWA identity for installed users; pick a permanent id now and change only start_url.

findings.title: Landing-first home (static / with app at /map), single h1, retire #seo-content; cloaking risk assessment
findings.evidence: 3 h1 in index.html (718 #seo-content, 744 splash, 753 noscript); #seo-content sits inside #root (717) under fixed #boot-splash and is removed by script at index.html:425 and by createRoot; after JS the indexed DOM is an app shell with no h1/copy (audit D2); perf-cwv-05 measured it as a leading LCP candidate. Google policy (fetched): cloaking = different content to users vs engines; hidden text = content not easily viewable by users. Same HTML goes to all UAs, text is truthful but never visible to users.
findings.root_cause: Content for crawlers was bolted under the splash because the app has no text surface.
findings.fix: Option 0 (interim, perf-cwv-05): one visible hero, splash h1 -> p. Option A (target): static / with h1, 40-60-word answer-first summary, CTA to /map, hub cards, three sourced facts, accuracy bullets, changelog snippet, crawlable footer; inline redirect script sends returning users (localStorage gtbg_seen) and deep links (?tick,t,at,unit,u,vignette,ancestor,ll,z,lat,lng) to /map preserving query/hash; /map is noindex,follow with its own visually-hidden h1; PWA start_url /map. Option B fallback: SSR shell with a permanent About drawer.
findings.acceptance_test: curl / shows exactly one h1, >=250 unique words, all hub links without JS; GSC URL Inspection rendered HTML has the same h1/copy; landing LCP <=1.5 s mobile lab; ?tick=300 and ?ancestor=U-20ME open the map directly; /map noindex and absent from sitemap.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: SEO (indexable home), LCP/FCP, AI-crawler visibility (E3, E4)
findings.correction: Evidence and Option A are sound (3 h1 at index.html:718/744/753; #seo-content inside #root; removal at 424-425 needs 3 labelled buttons; policy definitions correct). Gaps: SW registration and PRECACHE (index.html:258-275, sw.js) would install the whole app for every landing visitor (MISSED-2); site-nav.js:212 back-link/bfcache logic keys on a[href='/'] and the redirect gate uses gtbg_seen while existing users only have gtbg_onboarded=1 (bundle.pretty.js:112951, 113068) (MISSED-3).

findings.title: Structured data programme: one JSON-LD @graph per template, validated in CI
findings.evidence: JSON-LD exists only on index.html:27-38 (WebApplication without offers; nested Event without location). Search Central gallery (fetched) lists Article, Breadcrumb, Dataset, Event, Organization, Profile page, Software app, Video and no FAQ/HowTo/Sitelinks search box. Three samples written and parsed as valid JSON.
findings.root_cause: Only the home page got markup, hand-written.
findings.fix: Matrix in section 4.5: home WebSite+Person+WebApplication(offers 0, ViewAction)+Event as about (with location); Article+BreadcrumbList for moments/turning points/Q&A/guide; LearningResource for lessons; Place for places; Organization mainEntity for units; Person only for sourced commanders with confirmed sameAs; Dataset on /data; VideoObject later. No FAQ/HowTo/fabricated ratings; dateModified from git; CI schema check.
findings.acceptance_test: Rich Results Test and Schema Markup Validator 0 errors on one URL per template; GSC Breadcrumbs valid >=95% of indexable non-home URLs within 30 days; CI fails on Event without location.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Entity understanding, Breadcrumb rich results, Dataset Search eligibility
findings.correction: JSON-LD only at index.html:27-38, Event has no location, WebApplication no offers; search gallery lists Article/Breadcrumb/Dataset/Event/Organization/Profile page/Software app/Video and omits FAQ, HowTo and Sitelinks search box.

findings.title: Build-time dynamic OG images per page (Satori + resvg), with alt text and validation
findings.evidence: All 26 pages share one broken image; no og:image:alt anywhere.
findings.root_cause: No image pipeline.
findings.fix: Node step emits /og/<template>/<slug>.<hash8>.png 1200x630 <=120 KB: dark field, gold rule, eyebrow (date/place from TimeModel), 2-line serif title, own SVG mini-map with USGS contours (avoid Mapbox imagery pending terms review), wordmark; cache by input hash; emit og/twitter image + width/height/alt; default fallback.
findings.acceptance_test: CI decodes every image with Pillow, asserts 1200x630, <=200 KB and non-uniform pixels; 5 URLs pass Facebook and LinkedIn debuggers; alt present on all.
findings.correction: Broken image is referenced by 21 pages, not 'all 26' (6 files have no og:image).

findings.title: Static-first content pages: SVG mini-maps, no map engine on content pages, click-to-load only
findings.evidence: Sub-pages load a second 1.8 MB mapbox-gl from CDN (bundle-anatomy-18, pagesB-02); Mapbox token appears unrestricted (X1); JS-rendering crawlers on ~600 pages would burn billable map loads (free allowance was 50,000/month when last known; verify).
findings.root_cause: Every existing map page boots a full GL map on load.
findings.fix: Programmatic pages ship static HTML with inline SVG mini-map (<=15 KB, role=img with title/desc, real coordinates), 'Open on the interactive map' link, zero third-party requests, JS <=15 KB; where a live map helps, a 'Load interactive map' button injects Mapbox on click only. Budgets: HTML <=35 KB raw, CSS inline <=10 KB, LCP = text or SVG.
findings.acceptance_test: Lighthouse mobile >=98 on one page per template with 0 third-party requests; no mapbox request until button press; Mapbox map-loads flat during a staging crawl.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: LCP/INP for entry pages (site-wide RUM p75), cost/quota
findings.correction: 8 feature pages plus unit-rendering-reference load mapbox-gl 3.24.1 (1,796,551 B raw) from api.mapbox.com (not all sub-pages). Mapbox pricing: 50,000 free map loads, $5 per 1,000 beyond, counted on each GL JS init.

findings.title: Content-gated programmatic engine: generator, URL taxonomy, tiers, thin-content gate, staged release
findings.evidence: Measured on deploy:data: regiment median 17 usable words (47/466 >=30, 1 >=100); brigade pages median 120 words (0/101 >=250; 93 records for 101 ids, 8 VI Corps missing); 127 units share 48 duplicate key_action strings ('Army reserve.' x20); chronology labels compressed (Day 2: 8 events at 8 am, 1/hour 2-6 pm). Google spam policy defines scaled content abuse as many pages generated without adding value.
findings.root_cause: Dataset is a game-engine database with one-line prose per entity.
findings.fix: Astro getStaticPaths (or standalone Node script on the legacy tree) over data/v2 + entities + names + unit_counts + excerpts + TimeModel; 13 templates, ~340 Tier-A URLs (up to ~580 with Tier B and Q&A); slugs.lock.json append-only, /u/{id} short links; Tier A publish when gate passes, Tier B regiments only with enrichment (60 by day 90, up to ~180), Tier C (~390 units) anchored on brigade pages; CI gate (min words, boilerplate<=0.35, 5-gram similarity<0.5, >=6 facts, source, own lead, no dev-copy); release train <=100 URLs/week with owner read of 10 random pages; pause rule if 'Crawled - not indexed' >25%; block clock-time pages on app-time; counts from unit_counts lint.
findings.acceptance_test: gate-report.json with 0 Tier-A failures; per-template sitemaps; GSC per-sitemap indexed/submitted >=80% for batches >30 days old; no template >25% 'Crawled - currently not indexed'; raw HTML contains all content.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Indexable surface 21 -> ~340+, long-tail impressions, AI visibility
findings.correction: Duplicate key_action (127 units/48 strings), 40 units with 100+ char key_action, 93/101 brigades with 8 VI Corps missing and 151 units at 40%+ loss reproduce. Regiment stats differ slightly (median 18, 33 with 30+ words, 0 with 100+), and the brigade median is 112 with 0 at 250+; tier_proto.py itself prints median 146 and 4 at 250+ (it counts JSON keys), so the report's numbers are not reproducible from the cited script. Item 8 is factually wrong: Netlify redirects can match query params (/regiment unit=:unit /units/:unit 301!). 'flag note 31' and the union of 180 Tier-B candidates are not reproducible (157 with vignette-featured; chronology flags give 110).

findings.title: Enrichment corpus that makes entity pages genuinely unique (shared with Historian expansion)
findings.evidence: key_action >=100 chars for only 40 of 467; Historian-sources workstream already holds OR Vol. 27 text (tmp-hist-sources-1/or27_*.txt, quality not inspected); data notes at terrain.json:38, union_artillery.json:91, placements_day1_ticks1_50.json:80 name a 'Gettysburg Animated YouTube vignette'.
findings.root_cause: No prose layer beyond one-line key_action.
findings.fix: data/curated/excerpts.json schema {entity id, source id, locator, text<=120 words, scan url, license, reviewer}. Buckets: computed (loss-rate rank, share of brigade losses, distance moved, nearest landmark per keyframe, monuments within 300 m, succession chain, state cohort, vignette links via ancestors); public-domain primary text (OR Vol. 27, state monument-commission volumes, Dawes, Oates, Fox) verified on IA/HathiTrust; restricted (Busey and Martin book: attribute, get advice, consider asking publisher; Wikipedia CC BY-SA facts only); NPS content. Provenance check on the three YouTube-vignette notes before scaling or open-licensing. Extractor + human review queue + lint.
findings.acceptance_test: 60 Tier-B units each have >=1 approved primary excerpt and >=250 words, gate passes, every quote traceable to a scan in <=2 clicks.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Content depth, E-E-A-T, unit pages, AI citations
findings.correction: key_action 100+ chars = 40, OR27 text files exist, data notes at terrain.json:38, union_artillery.json:91 and placements_day1_ticks1_50.json:80 confirmed, license statements consistent. Extension: a fourth YouTube-vignette note at chronology_day1.json:31, and provenance includes copyrighted atlases and Google imagery (MISSED-5).

findings.title: Moment pages (24) and /moments hub
findings.evidence: 24 vignettes, 7,205 words (206-375 each); documentary.html:88-91 renders one at a time with no URLs; education.html:66 same JSON; SERP for 'what time did Pickett's Charge start' is ABT time-slice static maps, Wikipedia, HistoryNet, LoC.
findings.root_cause: Best narrative content has no addressable, crawlable form.
findings.fix: /moments/{slug}: h1 title, eyebrow date/time from TimeModel, 40-60-word answer-first block, paragraph-split narrative, who was there (ancestor-resolved units), the ground (SVG + place link), around this hour, debate link, per-vignette sources, map CTA, prev/next, cite box; >=450 words; title '{Vignette}, {Place}: July 2, 1863' (<=60); hub with day sections + ItemList; documentary player links to moment URLs.
findings.acceptance_test: 24 pages pass gate; raw HTML has full narrative; Rich Results Test valid Article+Breadcrumb; CTAs open right tick once app-time-06 ships; >=20 of 24 indexed within 45 days.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Long-tail queries, AI citations, internal-link hub
findings.correction: 24 vignettes, 208-378 words (total 7,271 vs 7,205: counting method), no per-vignette sources, documentary.html:88-92 and education.html:66 as described.

findings.title: Battle-by-day and part-of-day pages with hour anchors (blocked on time model)
findings.evidence: Chronology labels compressed (137 events, 38 distinct hours, Day 2 has 1 event/hour 2-6 pm); SERP for hourly timelines is CivilWarTalk, Stone Sentinels (3 day pages; July 2 has 40-50 entries, >15,000 words), History.com, ABT, Wikipedia.
findings.root_cause: Time model wrong (C4) and event density too sparse for 56 hour pages.
findings.fix: 3 day hubs + ~13 part-of-day pages with boundaries from corrected clock/event density; each: authored intro, timeline from TimeModel, computed 'where the corps were' table from placements, SVG casualty chart, moments/places in window, sources, >=500 words, h3 hour anchors; all-in-one chronicle from app-a11y-12 is noindex,follow to avoid duplicate text.
findings.acceptance_test: No clock time printed disagrees with TimeModel.format(tick) (link-checker); each page >=500 words; Pickett's Charge ~3 pm July 3, not 11:05 am.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: 'battle map by hour' queries, historical consistency
findings.correction: Chronology facts exact (137 events, 38 hour keys, Day 2 has 8 events at 8:05-8:55 am and 1 per hour 2:20-6:20 pm). Stone Sentinels competitor stats overstated: direct curl counts are about 6.3k (Jul 1), 9.4k (Jul 2, 22 timestamped entries) and 7.0k (Jul 3) words, not 15k+/40-50 entries. Strategy unaffected.

findings.title: Order-of-battle hub tree: corps, divisions, 101 brigades, gated regiment/battery pages
findings.evidence: 93 brigade records for 101 referenced ids (8 VI Corps missing); brigade-level positions stand in for 422 regiments (pagesB-44); alias stub U-14BK; competitor Stone Sentinels per-regiment pages have GPS, inscriptions, photos.
findings.root_cause: Unit content exists only inside a JS tool.

findings.title: Privacy-respecting analytics, event taxonomy, goals and privacy-policy update
findings.evidence: privacy.html lists only Netlify RUM and says no third-party analytics; Netlify Web Analytics (log-based, no events/UA breakdown, Log Drains via sales) is in use but undisclosed; terms forbid scraping while data is public.

findings.fix: Cookieless counter via first-party path on Netlify (Plausible/GoatCounter/Umami, or edge counter in Netlify Blobs) plus Netlify Web Analytics as cross-check; events (map_launch, play, unit_open, vignette_open, search_used boolean only, ancestor_lookup state only, share_copy, embed_load host only, kit_download, classroom_share_click, outbound_click host, cite_copy, correction_click, historian_feedback thumbs); goals (landing->map >=45%, engaged >=55%, state->unit >=25%); honour GPC/DNT; UTM policy with replaceState stripping; update privacy/terms (Netlify Web Analytics, vendor, events, Mapbox telemetry, PeerJS).
findings.acceptance_test: Dashboards show pageviews/events/referrers within 24 h; network capture shows no third-party origin and no personal fields; GPC-on sends nothing; policy diff dated.
findings.correction: privacy.html lists only Netlify RUM and omits Netlify Web Analytics; PeerJS loaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net is also undisclosed; Netlify Analytics counting bots is supported by community sources.

findings.title: Bot-traffic segmentation protocol for Netlify analytics
findings.evidence: Germany 210, China 170, Singapore 152, Hong Kong 96 = 628 of 3,389 PV (18.5%); Netlify UI has no user-agent breakdown; scanner 404s (wp-admin 430, / 181, .git/config 78 ...) are a separate table and do not inflate pageviews; 328 MB/month bandwidth.
findings.root_cause: Server-side log analytics counts non-JS clients; no segmentation tooling.
findings.fix: E1 curl probes (default vs crawler UA) to test whether Netlify counts bots; E2 daily ratio Netlify PV / cookieless PV / RUM; E3 country cuts and page paths; E4 fingerprint rule (direct + non-US + single page + no events); E5 optional edge counter with Sec-Fetch-* heuristic, no IP stored; do not geo-block or add WAF; keep scanner 404 rules.
findings.acceptance_test: By day 14 docs/traffic-quality.md states the measured human-share estimate and method; every KPI states raw vs human-adjusted.
findings.correction: Germany 210, China 170, Singapore 152, Hong Kong 96 = 628 of 3,389 (18.5%) exact; the '/ 181 not found' row is consistent with OPTIONS / returning 404 (non-GET probes).

findings.title: Monitoring, SEO CI checks and weekly/monthly routines
findings.evidence: No monitoring exists; CI is being designed in prov-recon-38.

findings.fix: CI job 'seo': canonical, redirect matrix, og image decode/size/non-uniform, JSON-LD validation, sitemap parity, link check, title/description lengths, one h1, gate report, dev-copy and count lints, robots matrix, Lighthouse CI per template; post-deploy IndexNow + smoke curl + uptime monitor; weekly 15-minute GSC/Bing/Netlify review, monthly KPI and prompt checks; alerts on coverage/manual actions/deploy failure/404 spikes; GSC status definitions documented.
findings.acceptance_test: CI 'seo' job fails on any listed violation; docs/seo-runbook.md exists; first weekly review logged in week 1.
findings.correction: CI/monitoring design with no evidence to test.

findings.title: KPI dashboard, phase gates and risk register
findings.evidence: Baselines from Netlify PDFs: 3,389 PV, 1,529 UV, 2,221 referrals, search engines 173 (63+59+38+13), ChatGPT 14, RUM LCP/INP/CLS/FCP Poor.
findings.root_cause: No managed targets; no gates against thin or wrong content.
findings.fix: One sheet with weekly rows and KPIs (indexable URLs submitted/indexed, search referrals, Google clicks, AI referrals, referring domains, valid share previews, rich results, landing->map rate, engaged sessions, human-adjusted UV, kit/Classroom actions, CWV on content routes, branded impression share) with targets at D30/60/90/180/365 (D90: search referrals 173 -> 500, AI 14 -> 50, +20 referring domains); gates G1-G3; 12-item risk register; weekly plan W0-W12.
findings.acceptance_test: Sheet exists with week-0 baselines from PDFs and GSC/Bing after verification; 12 consecutive weekly rows filled.
findings.correction: Baselines verified (3,389 PV, 1,529 UV, search 173, ChatGPT 14; RUM LCP/INP/CLS/FCP Poor, FID Good); 'referrals 2,221' includes 2,034 Direct. Roadmap is over capacity (by the report's own sizes W3 = 11 person-days, W8 = 9, W9 = 11.5 vs about 4 d/week) and finding 14 (XL prerequisite for brigade and Tier-B pages) is never scheduled.

open_questions: Q1: Approve the brand 'Gettysburg Interactive Map' (drop 'Animated Battlefield Map', which collides with ABT and the paid Savas Beatie app)?

Q2: Licensing: is exposure from publishing Busey and Martin-derived strengths/losses acceptable (facts only, attributed, or ask the publisher)? Which licence for the dataset (recommend CC BY 4.0) and for vignette text?

Q3: Provenance: terrain.json:38, union_artillery.json:91 and placements_day1_ticks1_50.json:80 reference a 'Gettysburg Animated YouTube vignette' (the channel promoting the paid app). Were any positions or texts derived from that product? Any affiliation? Answer before open-licensing or scaling pages.
Q4: Allow AI training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot) on HTML while blocking /data/? (default recommendation: yes)
Q5: Landing-first (static / with app at /map, returning-user redirect) or keep the app at /? (default: landing-first)
Q6: Analytics vendor: Plausible (paid), GoatCounter (free), Umami, or self-built edge counters?
Q7: Who can be named as reviewers, and what real background facts go on the About page?
Q8: Weekly time budget and how much implementation is done by Claude sessions? (plan is ~77.5 person-days; ~50 in 90 days; 33-day core subset if under 3 days/week)
Q9: Does an older Search Console or Bing property still exist under another account (verification file was lost in deploy C)?
Q10: Confirm the site stays free with no paid tier (the deleted /landing.html advertised a trial) so Terms, Privacy, About and redirects agree.

Unverified items to check before publishing: daggered outreach targets, state archive URLs, exact Anthropic/Apple/Meta crawler token spellings, Mapbox current free-tier limits, 20th Maine strength (386 in data vs 358 elsewhere), standards codes (C3/CCSS), Remembrance Day 2026 date.
verification_summary: The seo-growth report holds up well. I found no REFUTED findings, and its headline evidence reproduced. That covers the corrupt PNG (IDAT 3,687,120 B vs 2,765,520 expected, 80 colours, day1/day3 md5 identical), the 10 pages missing twitter:card, the 10 /index.html back links, the Netlify Analytics rows read by PDF coordinates, the RDAP dates, the DNS/GSC-file loss, the 686 commander names, the 512 monuments with 9 src, the 48 duplicate key_action strings, the 93/101 brigades, and the 9 turning points averaging 116 words. Errors are in secondary facts: (1) state counts omit the 59 cavalry regiments, so it is 19 states plus Regular Army with 5 or more units, and VA is 59, not 42; (2) Stone Sentinels July 2 is about 9.4k words and 22 entries, not 15k+ and 40-50; (3) Netlify redirects CAN match query strings, so the JS redirect for /regiment?unit= is unnecessary; (4) setting the primary domain to the apex will not remove the http://www double hop; (5) Slack has no /unfurl command; (6) twitter:image is on 11 pages, not 21; (7) the cited tier_proto.py prints different brigade numbers than the report. Eight missed issues are listed. The biggest are: path-keyed netlify.toml rules do not cover extensionless twins (/diagnostics is live 200, /embed gets X-Frame-Options DENY); the landing-first design ignores the service-worker precache, the site-nav back-link/bfcache logic and the gtbg_onboarded key; the old GSC verification file could be restored in minutes; dataset provenance extends to copyrighted atlases and Google imagery; and the 90-day roadmap is over capacity and never schedules prerequisite finding 14. The verification section is appended to seo-growth.md, and scratch scripts are in plan-work/tmp-verify-seo-growth/.

missed_by_specialist.title: Path-keyed netlify.toml rules do not cover extensionless twins (diagnostics exposed, embed blocked, cache rule skipped)
missed_by_specialist.evidence: Live: /diagnostics.html 404 (force rule) but /diagnostics returns 200 with the internal diagnostics page (5,349 B, no robots meta); /embed.html sends frame-ancestors * but /embed sends X-Frame-Options: DENY; for='/*.html' Cache-Control does not apply to /dashboard. The report cites the diagnostics rule as proof of force=true but never notices the twin. prov-recon-35/36 keep .html canonicals while seo-growth-03 goes extensionless and does not reconcile this.
